name: topbox
description: 2-loop NON-planar 'topbox' of the gg->Zgamma exact-mt family (verbatim arXiv:2402.07311 momentum routing). Massless three-edge chain 4-1-2-3 plus massive top ring 4-6-3-5-4 (four m2 lines); externals p1@1, p2@2, p3@5, p4@6, all on-shell massless here (the Zgamma deformation puts p4^2 = MZ^2 at vertex 6); scales {s,t,m2}. Non-planar: joining the four external legs to a common apex gives a K3,3 minor (branch sets {apex},{3},{4} x {5},{6},{1,2}).
